title.en: Saying what you do not do

text.en:
Today you learn to say no.
I do not drive.
It means: I never drive a car.
We do not share a desk.
It means: each of us has our own desk.

With I, you, we and they, say do not.
I do not eat meat.
With one other person or one thing, say does not.
She does not smoke. The door does not lock.
The next word stays short: no s.

You will make short no-sentences.
Look at who the sentence is about.
I, we, you, they: do not.
She, he or one thing: does not.
Then add the action word.
The tap does not work. The buses do not run today.
